summary: Iter4 (bug+feature batch): 18/18 backend pytest passing (test_v2_features.py 12/12 after adjusting stale-hardware test to new spec + new test_iter4_features.py 5/5). Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified: New Patient BMI chip renders 25.9 for 162cm/68kg, notes textarea persists to patient profile (data-testid='patient-notes-block'), anthro-row rendered on profile. 2-min walk timer counts smoothly and strictly monotonically decreases (120 -> 119 -> 118 across 1s samples via data-testid='timer-display'). 30s leg-abduction Save button no longer sticks — after clicking Save the movement-stop-button disappears and flow advances. PDF now contains 'Assessed knee', 'Clinical interpretation', 'Sensor features' and BMI value '25.9', size > 7000 bytes. Hardware auto-fallback verified: with hardware_mode=hardware and stale (>4s) /hw/ingest, /assessment/live returns source='simulator', stale=true, non-zero features varying between polls; after fresh /hw/ingest the very next /assessment/live returns source='hardware', stale=false with features EXACTLY matching payload. Leg-abduction end-to-end + duplicate stop returns 409 as intended.

minor.issue: assessment_states/HW_STATE still process-global; pytest -n 2 --dist loadscope (shipped pytest.ini) races on shared state — must run with -n 0 (documented in previous iterations).
HW_STATE still a single process-wide dict — no per-device scoping (unchanged from iter3, acceptable for single-tenant demo).

action_items: None blocking. Consider running the pytest suite with -n 0 in CI (already documented). File size /app/backend/server.py now 586 lines — start modularising build_pdf/FEATURE_META and scoring before adding further PDF sections.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 586 lines (up from 473). build_pdf keeps growing (BMI, body diagram, clinical interpretation, feature meta table). Extract pdf.py + scoring.py before next iteration.
resolve_features silently downgrades hardware -> simulator when stale. UI must show 'Waiting for edge device' toast during live capture (currently only Settings device pill reflects this).

Client-side smooth timer in LiveStage seeds from Date.now() at start — good; but auto-finish and the Save button still both call stop; finishing guard is the correct fix (verified — no 'stuck on active' repro).

PatientInput accepts height_cm/weight_kg as Optional[float] with no range validation server-side (only frontend min/max). Consider Pydantic Field constraints to reject physically-impossible values (e.g., height_cm > 250 or < 40).
HW_STATE and assessment_states still module-globals — will not survive backend restart; unchanged from previous iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (BMI chip, notes block, monotonic timer, leg-abduction save)

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. The one initial pytest failure was in the pre-existing test 'test_hardware_stale_returns_baseline' which asserted the OLD behaviour (source='hardware' when stale). The new product spec (iter4) is to auto-fallback to simulator features when the last /hw/ingest is >4s stale — so the test was updated to assert source='simulator', stale=true, features vary between polls, and features do NOT equal the last stale payload.
